::: page-banner
# Abstracts
:::

::: {style="max-width: 860px; margin: 0.75rem auto 0 auto; padding: 0 1rem;"}
Masterclass abstracts for all sessions, listed in programme order. Registered participants will receive preparatory reading lists separately.
:::

```{=html}
<style>
/* Only layout and structure — all colours, fonts, and sizes
   inherit from the site's own SCSS / Bootstrap variables */

.abstracts-wrap {
  max-width: 860px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 1rem 2rem;
}

/* Day section headers */
.abs-day-header {
  margin-top: 2.5rem;
  padding-bottom: 0.35rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.abs-day-theme {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-style: italic;
  opacity: 0.6;
  margin: 0.2rem 0 0.3rem;
}

/* Card row */
.abs-card {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  padding: 1.75rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07);
}
.abs-card:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

/* Photo */
.abs-photo { flex-shrink: 0; }
.abs-photo img {
  width: 90px;
  height: 90px;
  border-radius: 40%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

/* Body */
.abs-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

/* Session badge — uses site's .text_block green for keynote */
.abs-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.07em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 2px 9px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
}
.abs-badge-keynote {
  background: #eaf4f1;
}

/* Title — inherits h-level weight and colour from SCSS */
.abs-title {
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
}

/* Speaker line */
.abs-speaker {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  opacity: 0.75;
  margin-bottom: 0.7rem;
}
/* Link colour inherits $link-color = $primary from SCSS — no override needed */

/* Abstract text */
.abs-text {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

/* Mobile */
@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .abs-card { flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; }
  .abs-photo img { width: 64px; height: 64px; }
}
</style>
```
